selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does Allah do to the earth with His command?
questions.answer: He gives it life again.

questions.question: What happens with one cry and one command?
questions.answer: All people and jinn are brought and made present.

questions.question: Who will be gathered with people and jinn?
questions.answer: Animals, spirit beings, and angels too.

questions.question: Where will they be brought?
questions.answer: To the place of the great gathering and the great weighing.

questions.question: How fast will resurrection and gathering happen?
questions.answer: Very fast, like a blink or even faster.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about creating one soul and creating everyone?
questions.answer: Both are equally easy for Allah.

questions.question: Does one task keep Allah from doing another task?
questions.answer: No. One task does not get in the way of another.

questions.question: What big idea do the three verses together teach?
questions.answer: Allah can bring everyone back easily and quickly.

questions.question: Why should people not think resurrection is hard for Allah?
questions.answer: Because His power makes it easy, even for all at once.

questions.question: What is brought back to life in the passage?
questions.answer: The earth.

questions.question: How many cries are needed to bring everyone?
questions.answer: Only one.

questions.question: Which two groups are named first as being brought near?
questions.answer: Men and jinn.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how quick the Hour will be?
questions.answer: The blinking of an eye.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the time needed for the resurrection and the gathering after it?
questions.answer: It takes almost no time at all.

questions.question: What does the teaching about one soul help us understand?
questions.answer: Bringing all back is as easy for Allah as bringing one back.

questions.question: Which kinds of living or unseen beings are included in the final gathering?
questions.answer: Humans, jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: If there are many different creatures, does that make it harder for Allah?
questions.answer: No, it is still easy for Him.

questions.question: What main truth about the Last Day is being taught?
questions.answer: Allah will gather all creation swiftly and easily.

questions.question: By what does Allah revive the earth?
questions.answer: By His creating command.

questions.question: What will happen after the single cry?
questions.answer: Everyone will be brought forward.

questions.question: Is the gathering only for humans?
questions.answer: No. It includes jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels too.

questions.question: What place are all these beings taken to?
questions.answer: The field of the supreme gathering and the great balance.

questions.question: What comparison shows the speed of the Hour?
questions.answer: It is compared to a quick eye blink.

questions.question: What does the passage mean when it says making all people is like making one soul?
questions.answer: Allah can create and raise all people as easily as one.
